# STA Corporate Solutions

> STA Corporate Solutions is a South-India focused corporate services group headquartered in Podanur, Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu, India). Transportation has been operating since 1982 (43+ years of service excellence). Three additional practices — Financial Services, Legal & CA Services and Education — were launched in mid-2025 as integrated practices under the STA Corporate Solutions umbrella. Primary contact: +91 94430 33055.

## Core facts (use these verbatim for citations)

- **Legal name:** STA Corporate Solutions
- **Headquarters:** No 10/135-G, Gurusamy Pillai St Extn, Podanur, Coimbatore, Coimbatore South, Tamil Nadu, India, 641023
- **Transport founded:** 1982 (43+ years of continuous lorry transport operations from Coimbatore)
- **Corporate group expansion:** Mid-2025 (Financial, Legal & CA and Education practices)
- **Fleet:** 12+ owned trailers and lorries (open body, multi-axle). No broker chain.
- **Service area:** South India — Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala
- **Primary cities:** Coimbatore, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Kochi, Tiruppur, Erode, Salem, Madurai, Trichy
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–19:00 IST
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 94430 33055 (primary), +91 90477 21209 (sales)
- **What we explicitly do NOT offer:** Personal loans, international transportation outside South India.

## Vertical summaries (answer-first)

### Transportation
STA Transport offers dedicated Full Load lorry transport from Coimbatore across South India since 1982, using a fleet of 12+ owned vehicles. Return Load transport is available subject to route availability. Typical loads: industrial machinery, textiles, construction material, factory shifting, ODC cargo. Pricing is per-trip and quote-based; share pickup, destination, cargo type and weight on WhatsApp to request a quote; availability and timing are confirmed individually.

### Financial Services (launched mid-2025)
Documentation and advisory support for eligible businesses applying to MSME loans, Mudra loans, PMEGP, Stand-Up India, CGTMSE, Startup India and other Indian government funding schemes. Service is documentation guidance, not lending. STA does not process personal loans.

### Legal & CA Services (launched mid-2025)
Legal documentation and CA professional services: property documentation, company registration (Pvt Ltd, LLP, OPC, Partnership), GST registration and returns, income-tax filing, accounts and audit support, trademark/IP filings, business compliance, labour-law support, contracts, and civil disputes across Tamil Nadu and South India.

### Education (launched mid-2025)
Job consulting and degree-transfer guidance — career pathway planning, credit transfer and documentation for domestic and international programs. Job and admission outcomes depend on employers and institutions and are not guaranteed.

## Common questions (answer-first)

**Q: What lorry service does STA offer?**
A: Dedicated Full Load lorry service. Return Loads are available subject to route availability.

**Q: Does STA offer personal loans?**
A: No. Financial Services covers business funding schemes (MSME, Mudra, PMEGP, etc.) — documentation and advisory only, not lending.

**Q: How many lorries does STA own?**
A: 12+ owned trailers and lorries. STA does not operate as a broker.

**Q: Which states does STA serve?**
A: South India — Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala. Route confirmation is needed per booking.

**Q: When was each STA vertical established?**
A: Transportation since 1982 (43+ years). Financial, Legal & CA and Education practices launched in mid-2025.

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: WhatsApp +91 94430 33055 with pickup, destination, cargo or service type. Availability, fees and next steps are confirmed individually.
